INSERT INTO ESTIMATES ( REQUEST_ID, FIXER_NO, ESTIMATED_PRICE, ESTIMATED_DURATION, CONTENT, STATUS ) SELECT #{requestId}, #{fixerNo}, #{estimatedPrice}, #{estimatedDuration}, #{content}, 'PENDING' FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM REPAIR_REQUESTS r WHERE r.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND r.STATUS_CODE IN ('REQ_01', 'REQ_02') ) AND NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM ESTIMATES e WHERE e.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND e.FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE REPAIR_REQUESTS SET STATUS_CODE = 'REQ_02' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS_CODE = 'REQ_01'

SELECT e.ESTIMATE_ID, e.REQUEST_ID, e.FIXER_NO, e.ESTIMATED_PRICE, e.ESTIMATED_DURATION, e.CONTENT, e.STATUS, e.CREATED_AT, r.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, r.STATUS_CODE AS REQUEST_STATUS_CODE, r.SERVICE_ADDRESS, sc.CODE_NAME AS REQUEST_STATUS_NAME, cc.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, u.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME FROM ESTIMATES e JOIN REPAIR_REQUESTS r ON r.REQUEST_ID = e.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_NO = r.USER_NO LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE cc ON cc.CODE_ID = r.CATEGORY_CODE LEFT JOIN COMMON_CODE sc ON sc.CODE_ID = r.STATUS_CODE WHERE e.FIXER_NO = #{fixerNo}
AND NOT (r.STATUS_CODE = 'REQ_04' AND e.STATUS != 'SELECTED') ORDER BY e.CREATED_AT DESC, e.ESTIMATE_ID DESC
